steps.title: Template Manager: what a scene loads
steps.body: Window > Template Manager lists your scene templates: saved scenes whose layers, view and dates can follow the newest data. Open one to start from it, or duplicate, rename, edit, share or retire it.

steps.title: Make a template
steps.body: File > Save as Template keeps the scene on screen as a template, with a name, a description, a thumbnail and a time rule. File > New from Template starts from one.

steps.title: Study Manager: what a scene exports
steps.body: Window > Study Manager holds a table of views of one scene, each with its own projection, lambda, field of view or layers. Export set writes every picture with a manifest. Load template and Save as template keep a set of rows to reuse on another scene.

steps.title: Add views as you go
steps.body: Movie > Save View to Study adds the view on screen to the Study Manager as a new row, without opening it.

steps.title: Cache Manager: what is on disk
steps.body: Window > Cache Manager lists what is already on this computer: Studio's own downloads and the FITS library. Load a dataset as a layer, reveal it, delete it to get the space back, or import a folder of FITS into the library.

steps.title: Task Manager: what is running
steps.body: Window > Task Manager shows what is downloading, loading or computing, anything that did not land, and the export queue. The spinner at the bottom left opens it too.
